edits.old: - No approval is required to run a Draft migration on a development database; the migration is released to SIT only after the checks of section 16 pass.
edits.new:
- No approval is required to run a Draft migration on a development database; the migration is released to SIT only after the checks of section 16 pass.
- The completeness target and the gap alert threshold of the ledger are five minutes each (Architecture v5 slide 28), each held as one reference-data row; the maximum strict-mode wait is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1617) and is confirmed at the ADR-022 sign-off.
- The DecisionRecorded event carries a contract version set in the event and messaging design (RWB-PLT-TE006-CON); the ledger row records it under a column name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1622; ASM-2196).
- The ledger consumer group is rwb-decision-ledger; the lag alert fires at five minutes of lag and the dead-letter alert at the first dead letter; the append-only verification job runs at 01:00, one hour before the 02:00 chain check (JOB-14); the immutable-storage (WORM) path per environment is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1233) and is agreed with the storage owner.

disposition.change: Align the test lists for REQ-DRI-001 and the other two requirements with RWB-P7-E1008-DB section 18 in the next RTM version.
disposition.note: Test lists for three requirements differ; the fix is in the RTM and the next version of section 18.
The file name V_E1_008__declog_chain.sql is not in the supplied story text and the next number of the service sequence is not in the source.
The Physical Schema v6 citation is not in the supplied story parts, so no exact old text can be matched.

disposition.change: Add a contract version to the DecisionRecorded event, let the consumer accept a known set of versions and send an unknown one to the dead-letter topic.
disposition.note: Section 3 now records the contract version on the ledger row; the event contract change sits in the event design.
Five minutes recorded for completeness target and alert; strict-mode wait bound is not specified and is confirmed at ADR-022 sign-off.

disposition.change: Audit search reads the ledger only and shows entries not yet collected by JOB-13 as not yet sealed; strict mode waits for the ledger acknowledgement of its own record.
disposition.note: Search and strict-mode behaviour belong to the app story, not this database story.

disposition.change: Correct the rwb-decision read path from /decisions to /decision-log in the next architecture version.
disposition.note: Keep /decision-log as the published path; the architecture slides carry the wrong name.
Group, lag and dead-letter alerts, 01:00 verification job recorded in section 3; WORM path remains Not specified, agreed with storage owner.

disposition.change: Publish page 1, size 50, maximum 200 and an RFC 9457 problem body with type, title, status, detail and message identifier when the filters are added.
disposition.note: Paging and error body values belong to the contract story.

disposition.change: Publish the decision_record column set, types and canonical-form rule; add DECISION_LOG to the TSD P4 RBAC matrix; fix per-service login names; state the Temporal and Drools verifier behaviour.
disposition.note: Column set and canonical form belong to the shared library specification and related designs.
